title: Re:Zero — What Science Actually Says #Shorts
description:
The self that experiences Re:Zero is a committee, not a king. It started serialization as a web novel on the user-generated website Shōsetsuka ni Narō in 2012. 46 light novels, as well as six side story volumes and fourteen short story collections have been published by Media Factory under their MF Bunko J imprint. The story centers on Subaru Natsuki, a hikikomori who suddenly finds himself transported to another world while on his way home from a convenience store.

The cold light on Re:Zero leaves the facts intact and only the comfort removed. A manga adaptation of the novel Re:Zero Prequel: The Frozen Bond (Re：ゼロから始める前日譚 氷結の絆), released with the Season 1 Blu-rays, was illustrated by Minori Tsukahara and released from 2020 to 2021. An Internet radio show to promote the series, named Re: Radio life in a different world from zero (Re：ゼロから始める異世界ラジオ生活), began broadcasting on March 27, 2016.
